name: Practice gazetteer - west Houston / Katy (APPROXIMATE coordinates, for learning only)

properties.name: I-10 (Katy Freeway)
properties.description: Major interstate running east-west from Katy to downtown Houston; the main commuter route in west Houston.

properties.name: Grand Parkway (SH 99)
properties.description: Outer loop tollway running north-south through Katy and Cinco Ranch.

properties.name: SH 6
properties.description: State highway running north-south past Addicks and Barker reservoirs.

properties.name: Beltway 8 (Sam Houston Tollway)
properties.description: Tollway loop around Houston; its west section runs north-south.

properties.name: Westheimer Road (FM 1093)
properties.description: Busy east-west arterial with shopping centers through west Houston and Cinco Ranch.

properties.name: Clay Road
properties.description: East-west road through north Katy and the Bear Creek area.

properties.name: Fry Road
properties.description: North-south road through Katy and Cinco Ranch neighborhoods.

properties.name: Buffalo Bayou
properties.description: Bayou that starts near Barker Reservoir and flows east through Houston; prone to flooding.

properties.name: Addicks Reservoir
properties.description: Large flood-control reservoir north of I-10; flooded nearby neighborhoods during Hurricane Harvey.

properties.name: Barker Reservoir
properties.description: Flood-control reservoir south of I-10 near Cinco Ranch and the Energy Corridor.

properties.name: Bear Creek Pioneers Park
properties.description: Large county park inside Addicks Reservoir with sports fields and trails.

properties.name: George Bush Park
properties.description: Large park inside Barker Reservoir, popular for trails and ball fields.

properties.name: Katy Mills mall
properties.description: Large outlet mall on I-10 in Katy, a well-known local landmark.

properties.name: Energy Corridor
properties.description: Business district along I-10 with many energy company offices.

properties.name: Cinco Ranch
properties.description: Large master-planned community south of I-10 in Katy.

properties.name: Memorial Hermann Katy Hospital
properties.description: Hospital near I-10 in Katy.

properties.name: Downtown Houston
properties.description: Central business district of Houston.

properties.name: NRG Stadium
properties.description: Football stadium and rodeo grounds in south Houston.

properties.name: Sugar Land Town Square
properties.description: Shopping and civic center in Sugar Land.

properties.name: Cypress
properties.description: Community in northwest Harris County.
